claims.claim: exp-002 successfully produced three NVFP4 W4A4 pilot quantized Qwen3-4B variants for general_chat, code, and math_reasoning calibration domains.
claims.notes: Each quantize log has status=completed and scores.json records 3/3 completed variants.

claims.claim: Each completed pilot variant used 20 synthetic calibration samples and max_seq_length=2048.
claims.notes: The calibration manifest and quantize logs record the sample count and max sequence length.

claims.claim: A held-out synthetic NLL evaluation was run for base and all three NVFP4 variants on general_chat, code, and math_reasoning.
claims.notes: eval_nll.json has 12 model/domain rows: 4 models times 3 domains.

claims.claim: Matched calibration did not produce the best quantized NLL in any of the three synthetic evaluation domains.
claims.notes: Best quantized variants are nvfp4_code for general_chat, nvfp4_general_chat for code, and nvfp4_general_chat for math_reasoning.

claims.claim: The current pilot is not final evidence about real calibration-domain effects.
claims.notes: Both calibration and evaluation manifests identify the data as synthetic pilot data.
